◆ Trailblazer Profile ◆
Trailblazers can check here to view and edit their personal summary and review their Trailblaze Activity.
● Trailblaze Activity includes updates about the 5-star characters or Light Cones you've obtained for the first time, Treasures Lightward, Currency Wars, and Simulated Universe completion statuses, along with event completion statuses, and more.
● Other Trailblazers can view your Trailblaze Activity, and you can choose to stop showing your Trailblaze Activity to other Trailblazers in your Social Settings.
● The Trailblaze Activity is kept for up to <unbreak>30</unbreak> days and is limited to <unbreak>15</unbreak> entries max.

◆ Character Showcase ◆
● Trailblazers can display their obtained characters they wish to showcase here.
● Other Trailblazers can view all your showcased characters.

◆ Collection Showcase ◆
● Trailblazers can showcase their various collection statistics here.
● Other Trailblazers can view your collection showcase, and you can choose to stop showing your collection showcase to other Trailblazers in your Social Settings.

◆ Battle Records Showcase ◆
● Trailblazers can showcase the Battle Records for Treasures Lightward, current rank of Currency Wars, and titles obtained in the highest difficulty worlds cleared in the Simulated Universe to their friends.
● At the same time, Trailblazers can select whether to display their Battle Records to showcase to their friends in their Friend List.
● Friends can view your displayed Battle Record information, but you can choose to stop showing your Battle Records to your Friend List in your Social Settings.

◆ Support ◆
●  Set support characters to help other players.
● When other players use your support characters to complete a battle, Trailblazers can get a certain amount of rewards. These rewards can be obtained <unbreak>10</unbreak> times a day.
● Once the rewards accumulate to a certain amount, exceeding the limit won't grant additional rewards.

The power granted from the stellar seas gifted the Church the strength to punish devils, but also spread an insanity that ate away at human rationality.

Tormented by this madness, the Knights of the Church could no longer discern decorum and order, obsessed with expelling all devil-spawns for the salvation of the whole church. When these threats came for the Maiden, Safina had no time to hesitate. She cannot stay her hand even if her opponent was the Arch Knight of the Church of Purity Palace.

The Solemn Knight must always protect and defend the Maiden. Safina did not forget that creed.

"My dear Safina, there is no need to feel guilty. This is the consequence of coveting the power of the Aeons." All there were left in the church were the last Maiden and her guardian knight.
